copy.tagline: 为应用接入用户行为分析和功能开关
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在产品中快速集成分析工具和功能开关。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate user analytics and feature flags into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly add analytics and feature flags to your product.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你配置 PostHog 分析工具和功能开关。它会生成客户端（posthog-js）和服务端（posthog-node）的安装代码、环境变量设置，并提醒你注意浏览器端初始化、服务端刷新等关键规则。
howto.when: 当你需要在新项目中首次设置 PostHog，或配置 PostHogProvider、posthog-node 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 PostHog 客户端分析，使用 posthog-js。
配置服务端 posthog-node 单例，用于 API 路由事件捕获。
say.note: Claude 会创建服务端客户端并说明刷新模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you set up PostHog analytics and feature flags. It generates client-side (posthog-js) and server-side (posthog-node) setup code, environment variables, and reminds you of critical rules like browser-only initialization and server-side flushing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up PostHog for the first time in a project, configure PostHogProvider, or set up posthog-node for server-side event capture.

say_en.text: Set up PostHog client-side analytics using posthog-js.
say_en.note: Claude generates client init code and Provider config.

say_en.text: Configure a server-side posthog-node singleton for API route event capture.
say_en.note: Claude creates server client and explains flush patterns.
